title: Victoria and Butchart Gardens Day Trip
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the best of Vancouver Island on this scenic full-day tour to The Butchart Gardens and Victoria. Travel in a comfortable small-group setting and enjoy a beautiful BC Ferries ride through the Gulf Islands.

Explore the world-renowned Butchart Gardens, then discover Victoria’s highlights, including historic Chinatown, colorful Fisherman's Wharf, and the scenic Inner Harbour.

Enjoy free time to stroll along Government Street, visit the Parliament Buildings, dine at local restaurants, or simply relax and take in Victoria’s coastal charm.

Why travelers choose this tour:
• Small-group experience — no large buses
• Scenic ferry ride included
• Butchart Gardens admission included
• Free time to explore Victoria
• Comfortable transportation with a professional driver

Experience Victoria with comfort, flexibility, and unforgettable coastal views.
